_comment: Per-domain starter briefs for tools/make-context.js (output: context/<domain>.md). 'read' = the ONLY files the agent opens at the start; changes/<domain>.md and todo/<domain>.md are added automatically. Keep each list short (limit in tests/js/context.test.js).

sidebar.brief: The left panel: place list and details, search and period, layers, categories, languages, place editing. Talks to the map only through AHM.map.* and events (INTERFACES.md I-2).

map.brief: The MapLibre map: base maps, place symbols, overlays, route, pins. Provides the AHM.map commands and map events (I-2) and typeIcon (I-4).

core.brief: Pure logic without DOM: data loading, dates, search/sort/filter, layer rules, providers. Provides the core functions of I-3.

state.brief: The state manager: the one module that holds state shared between domains, as AHM.state (I-6, proposal 003). Built test-first.

campaigns.brief: The military-campaigns feature: an isolated add-on in app/features/campaigns/, loaded only when switched on (I-5). Touches nothing outside its folder.

data.brief: The back end: page controller, file store, endpoints and formats (I-1), the Node dev mirror. Keeps PHP and dev/save-handler.js in step.

shared.brief: Owner-only integration: domain table, interfaces, config, index.html, shared tests and tools, reviewing and merging the agents' pull requests.
